name: Adobe Acrobat Pro
whatYouLose: WYSIWYG editing of text and images inside an existing PDF
Legally backed e-signature workflows and signature tracking
Certified-grade redaction and PDF/A or accessibility preflight
Desktop and mobile apps with offline use
notes: Merge, split, extract, fill forms, OCR and create are well covered by the pdf skill’s scripts. Anything you would do by clicking on the page is not.
